name: alert-trust
description: Self-check skills for the whole alert chain, split per component: alert-trust-core (Prometheus, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics/vmalert/vmagent/VictoriaLogs, Grafana Alerting, Alertmanager, rule review and aggregation) plus one plugin per database and one for hosts, all reading the alert-trust catalog

plugins.name: alert-trust-core
plugins.description: Interactive self-check of the alert chain (collect, write, query, evaluate, route, receive): env profile, read-only snapshot, metric-source check, coverage gaps, timing contracts with fix options, rule review, and component packs for Prometheus, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana Alerting and Alertmanager; aggregates the database and host plugins (alert-trust-<db>) when installed

plugins.name: alert-trust-host
plugins.description: alert-trust host and container pack: checks the host card (node_exporter, cAdvisor, kube-state-metrics) in five sections; depends on alert-trust-core

plugins.name: alert-trust-mysql
plugins.description: alert-trust MySQL pack: checks the mysql card in five sections (architecture, usage, observe, misuse incl. bad queries, blind spots); depends on alert-trust-core
